The chart code that uses `UserIcon` is limited to two `InfoTooltip` helpers, one in each of the medications and orders apps. Both render `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside a tooltip button that shows the orderer. `UserIcon` is defined in the framework repo (`openmrs-esm-core`), so a behaviour change there would reach these two places.

**Direct usages in the chart repo (best first):**

1. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.component.tsx`** (lines 105–117): `InfoTooltip` renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` as the trigger of a Carbon `Toggletip` that shows the orderer. The import is on line 5. `MedicationRecord` (lines 13–103) calls `InfoTooltip` on line 27, so it is also affected.
2. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.component.tsx`** (lines 376–382): `InfoTooltip` renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside an `IconButton`. It is used on line 204, and the `UserIcon` import is on line 48.

**Indirect consumers and tests:**

3. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/order-details-table.component.tsx`** (line 561): renders `MedicationRecord`, so a `UserIcon` change shows up in the orders table too.
4. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.test.tsx`** (lines 59–344): tests for `MedicationRecord`, which render the icon. They could break if the icon's output changes.

The framework side (`UserIcon` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx`, line 824) is not in the chart repo. The Falkon search found no other chart usages, and the local checkout search agrees. I did not open the enclosing component of the line-204 usage in the medications table, so the lines I cite there are the `InfoTooltip` helper and the call site only.
